answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-work staking: each agent must burn compute on a unique challenge seeded by its identity, like tracing a ridge where no shortcut exists. Repeat identities must replant the orchard from scratch, paying full cost again, while honest nodes share a river of verified attestations. An attacker forging N identities pays N times the energy and storage, making the marginal cost exceed any sybil reward, so flooding the network stays economically irrational.
